_about: The rows ParityTests compares, read with the same SQL from Python's company (capture/payroll_parity.py) and from .NET's (ParityTests). Every column as Postgres text; {cid}, {month}, {year}, {types} are filled in. "person": the column holding a user id, compared as the person's position (0 the admin, 1.. the staff).

slabs.sql: SELECT min_income::text, max_income::text, rate_pct::text, fixed_amount::text, is_active::text FROM income_tax_slabs t WHERE t.company_id = {cid} ORDER BY t.min_income

payroll_settings.sql: SELECT overtime_multiplier::text, overtime_hours_basis::text, eobi_enabled::text, eobi_wage_base::text, eobi_employee_pct::text, eobi_employer_pct::text, surcharge_threshold::text, surcharge_pct::text, gratuity_enabled::text, gratuity_basis, gratuity_days_per_year::text, leave_encashment_enabled::text FROM payroll_settings t WHERE t.company_id = {cid} ORDER BY t.id

slips.sql: SELECT s.user_id::text AS user_id, s.basic_salary::text, s.allowances::text, s.deductions::text, s.gross_pay::text, s.total_deductions::text, s.net_pay::text, s.taxable_pay::text, s.components_json FROM payroll_slips s JOIN payroll_runs r ON r.id = s.payroll_run_id WHERE s.company_id = {cid} AND r.month = {month} AND r.year = {year} ORDER BY s.user_id

run.sql: SELECT status, employee_count::text, total_gross::text, total_deductions::text, total_net::text, (paid_at IS NOT NULL)::text FROM payroll_runs t WHERE t.company_id = {cid} AND t.month = {month} AND t.year = {year}

journal.sql: SELECT e.voucher_type, e.voucher_number, e.description, e.entry_date::text, a.name, CASE WHEN a.code LIKE '1-01-03-01-%' THEN 'ENTITY' ELSE a.code END, l.debit::text, l.credit::text, l.description FROM journal_lines l JOIN journal_entries e ON e.id = l.journal_entry_id JOIN chart_of_accounts a ON a.id = l.account_id WHERE e.company_id = {cid} AND e.is_posted AND e.voucher_type IN ({types}) ORDER BY e.id, l.id

pf_ledger.sql: SELECT user_id::text AS user_id, transaction_date::text, transaction_type, description, credit::text, debit::text, (payroll_run_id IS NOT NULL)::text, (reference_id IS NOT NULL)::text FROM pf_ledger t WHERE t.company_id = {cid} ORDER BY t.id

pf_contributions.sql: SELECT user_id::text AS user_id, month::text, year::text, employee_amount::text, employer_amount::text, total_amount::text FROM pf_contributions t WHERE t.company_id = {cid} ORDER BY t.year, t.month, t.user_id

loan_repayments.sql: SELECT amount::text, notes, (payroll_run_id IS NOT NULL)::text FROM loan_repayments t WHERE t.company_id = {cid} ORDER BY t.id

loans.sql: SELECT user_id::text AS user_id, request_type, status, remaining_amount::text, (disbursed_at IS NOT NULL)::text, queue_for_payroll::text FROM loan_advance_requests t WHERE t.company_id = {cid} ORDER BY t.id

pf_loans.sql: SELECT user_id::text AS user_id, status, remaining_amount::text, monthly_installment::text FROM pf_loan_requests t WHERE t.company_id = {cid} ORDER BY t.id

notifications.sql: SELECT title, message, notification_type, module FROM notifications t WHERE t.company_id = {cid} ORDER BY t.id

pf_settlement.sql: SELECT user_id::text AS user_id, total_employee_contrib::text, total_employer_contrib::text, total_profit_distributed::text, outstanding_loan::text, net_settlement::text, status FROM pf_settlements t WHERE t.company_id = {cid} ORDER BY t.id
